_meta.source: fal OpenAPI schemas fetched 2026-10-09 from https://fal.ai/api/openapi/queue/openapi.json?endpoint_id=<id> (same data as the /api doc pages); status from https://api.fal.ai/v1/models
_meta.range_durations: when duration.values is {min,max}, the field is numeric (integer unless noted) — send a JSON number
deprecated_excluded: fal-ai/luma-dream-machine/ray-2(-flash)/image-to-video (schema still served; not in active list, status unconfirmed)

image.label: Nano Banana (Gemini 2.5 Flash Image)
image.notes: Edit variant aspect_ratio adds 'auto' (default 'auto'). image_urls required on /edit; no max stated in schema. num_images 1-4. safety_tolerance string '1'-'6' default '4'. Output images[].url plus 'description' text.

image.label: Gemini 2.5 Flash Image
image.notes: Same schema as fal-ai/nano-banana (same underlying model). Edit aspect_ratio adds 'auto' (default 'auto').

image.label: Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image)
image.notes: Edit variant aspect_ratio default 'auto'. Extra optional: enable_web_search (bool), system_prompt. No max refs stated in schema.

image.label: Nano Banana 2 (Gemini 3.1 Flash Image)
image.notes: Extra optional: thinking_level ('minimal'|'high'), enable_web_search, system_prompt. /edit also accepts video_url, audio_url, pdf_url (image_urls optional when one of those given). No max refs stated.

image.label: Nano Banana 2.1
image.notes: Newest (2026-10-06); note 'google/' namespace not 'fal-ai/'. thinking_level 'minimal'|'medium'|'high' default 'medium'. /edit also takes video_url, pdf_url. No max refs stated.

image.label: FLUX.1 [dev]
image.notes: image_size also accepts {width,height}. num_inference_steps 1-50 (28), guidance_scale 1-20 (3.5), acceleration none|regular|high.

image.label: FLUX.1 [schnell]
image.notes: image_size also accepts {width,height}. num_inference_steps 1-12 (default 4).

image.label: FLUX1.1 [pro]
image.notes: image_size also accepts {width,height}. safety_tolerance string '1'-'6' default '2'. enhance_prompt bool.

image.label: FLUX1.1 [pro] ultra
image.notes: Optional single image_url (image prompt) with image_prompt_strength 0-1 (0.1) — not a true edit. raw (bool) for natural look.

image.label: FLUX.1 Kontext [pro]
image.notes: Edit endpoint takes a single image_url (string, required); its aspect_ratio has no default (nullable). For multiple refs use fal-ai/flux-pro/kontext/multi (image_urls list, experimental, no max stated).

image.label: FLUX.1 Kontext [max]
image.notes: Same shape as Kontext pro. Multi-ref variant: fal-ai/flux-pro/kontext/max/multi (image_urls).

image.label: FLUX.2 [dev]
image.notes: image_size accepts {width,height} 512-2048; on /edit image_size nullable with no default. Edit: max 4 images (extra ignored, per description).

image.label: FLUX.2 [pro]
image.notes: /edit image_size adds 'auto' (default 'auto'). safety_tolerance '1'-'5' default '2'. No num_images field. No max refs stated in schema.

image.label: FLUX.2 [max]
image.notes: Same shape as flux-2-pro. No num_images field; /edit image_size adds 'auto' (default).

image.label: FLUX 3
image.notes: New 'blackforestlabs/' namespace (2026-10-01). No num_images field. safety_tolerance is INTEGER 0-4 (default 2). image_urls minItems 1 maxItems 10, each >=256px. version const 'latest'.

image.label: Seedream 4.0
image.notes: Default image_size is an object {width:2048,height:2048}. No output_format field. num_images 1-6, max_images 1-6 (multi-image). Edit: up to 10 refs (last 10 used).

image.label: Seedream 4.5
image.notes: No 'auto' preset (only auto_2K/auto_4K). Width/height 1920-4096. No output_format. Edit: up to 10 refs.

image.label: Seedream 5.0 Pro
image.notes: 'bytedance/' namespace. Total pixels 1024x1024..2048x2048. Edit: up to 10 refs (last 10 used). Also v5 lite/flash exist.

image.label: Qwen Image
image.notes: Edit mapping is my choice: qwen-image-edit-plus takes image_urls (list; its image_size default 'square_hd'). fal-ai/qwen-image-edit takes a single image_url instead. Newer: fal-ai/qwen-image-edit-2511 (image_urls, output_format adds webp).

image.label: Qwen Image 3
image.notes: Edit requires 1-3 images (from description); edit image_size nullable, no default (model decides). num_images 1-6.

image.label: Ideogram V3
image.notes: No output_format. rendering_speed TURBO|BALANCED|QUALITY (BALANCED). style AUTO|GENERAL|REALISTIC|DESIGN. image_urls here are STYLE references, not edit inputs. fal-ai/ideogram/v3/edit requires mask_url+image_url (inpaint); /remix takes single image_url + strength.

image.label: Ideogram V4.5
image.notes: Edit: primary image_url (required string) + optional reference_image_urls (max 4) + optional mask_url; edit image_size adds 'auto' (default). quality low|medium|high (t2i), very_low..high (edit). No output_format.

image.label: Recraft V3
image.notes: No num_images or output_format. style enum (any, realistic_image, digital_illustration, vector_illustration, ...). Newer Recraft V4/V4.1 exist.

image.label: GPT Image 1
image.notes: image_size is a string WxH enum (not presets). quality auto|low|medium|high. background auto|transparent|opaque. Edit adds input_fidelity low|high.

image.label: GPT Image 1.5
image.notes: Text endpoint has no 'auto' size; edit image_size adds 'auto' (default). quality low|medium|high default high. Edit optional mask_image_url.

image.label: GPT Image 2
image.notes: 'openai/' namespace. image_size presets or {width,height}; edit default 'auto'. quality auto|low|medium|high (high). Edit max 16 refs, optional mask_url.

image.label: GPT Image 2.5 Flare
image.notes: quality auto|low|medium|high|xhigh|max (high). num_images up to 10. output_compression 0-100. A 'sunburst' sibling exists (openai/gpt-image-2.5/sunburst/...), not inspected.

image.label: Grok Imagine Image
image.notes: Edit aspect_ratio adds 'auto' (default). Edit max 3 images (from description). v2.0 exists at xai/grok-imagine-image/v2.0/...

video.label: Kling 2.5 Turbo Pro
video.notes: Optional tail_image_url (end frame). negative_prompt, cfg_scale optional. No aspect/resolution fields.

video.label: Kling 2.5 Turbo Standard
video.notes: No end frame on standard.

video.label: Kling 2.6 Pro
video.notes: First frame field is start_image_url (NOT image_url). Optional end_image_url. generate_audio bool default true; voice_ids optional.

video.label: Kling 3.0 Standard
video.notes: start_image_url required; prompt optional (prompt OR multi_prompt). end_image_url optional. generate_audio default true. elements, shot_type customize|intelligent.

video.label: Kling 3.0 Pro
video.notes: Same schema as v3 standard. Also v3/turbo/{standard,pro} and v3/4k variants exist (not inspected).

video.label: Kling O3 Pro
video.notes: Uses image_url (unlike v3). end_image_url optional. generate_audio default FALSE. prompt or multi_prompt.

video.label: Veo 3.1
video.notes: Duration strings carry an 's' suffix. generate_audio default true. safety_tolerance '1'-'6'. Image should be >=720p 16:9 or 9:16.

video.label: Veo 3.1 Fast
video.notes: Same schema as Veo 3.1.

video.label: Veo 3.1 Lite
video.notes: No 4k.

video.label: Seedance 1.0 Pro
video.notes: Optional end_image_url, num_frames 29-289 overrides duration, camera_fixed bool.

video.label: Seedance 1.0 Pro Fast
video.notes: No end frame. Seedance 1.0 Lite i2v is deprecated and redirects here.

video.label: Seedance 1.5 Pro
video.notes: aspect default 16:9 (not auto). generate_audio default true. Optional end_image_url.

video.label: Seedance 2.0
video.notes: 'bytedance/' namespace. generate_audio default true. Optional end_image_url, bitrate_mode, codec. A '/us/' variant exists.

video.label: Seedance 2.0 Fast
video.notes: Max 720p.

video.label: Seedance 2.5
video.notes: aspect_ratio is const 'auto' (omit it). prompt is optional (nullable). Up to 30s. draft bool (480p preview).

video.label: Hailuo 02 Standard
video.notes: Uppercase 'P' in resolution. Optional end_image_url, prompt_optimizer bool.

video.label: Hailuo 02 Pro (1080p)
video.notes: No duration or resolution field in schema (fixed; 1080p per model description). Length not stated in schema. Optional end_image_url.

video.label: Hailuo 2.3 Standard
video.notes: No resolution field. prompt_optimizer optional.

video.label: Hailuo 2.3 Pro
video.notes: No duration/resolution fields (fixed; length not stated in schema).

video.label: MiniMax H3
video.notes: duration is an INTEGER 5-15. image_url optional in schema (omitted -> text-to-video). Optional end_image_url, target_audio_url. prompt_expansion_mode disabled|fast|balanced|quality (default balanced).

video.label: MiniMax H3 Max
video.notes: duration is a float 0.92-15. prompt_expansion_mode is REQUIRED in schema (send 'balanced'). image_url optional.

video.label: Wan 2.2 A14B
video.notes: No duration field: length = num_frames (int 17-161, default 81) / frames_per_second (int 4-60, nullable; example 16). Optional end_image_url.

video.label: Wan 2.5 Preview
video.notes: Optional audio_url (background music). Prompt max 1500 chars.

video.label: Wan 2.6
video.notes: 'wan/' namespace. multi_shots bool, optional audio_url.

video.label: Wan 3.0
video.notes: start_image_url required; prompt optional. duration INTEGER 2-30 or null (smart duration). audio bool default true. Optional end_image_url, enable_thinking.

video.label: Luma Ray 3.2
video.notes: 10s requires multi-keyframe input (keyframes/keyframe_indexes) — use '5s' for single first frame. image_url nullable in schema. loop, hdr, end_image_url optional.

video.label: PixVerse V5
video.notes: 1080p limited to 5s. style optional.

video.label: PixVerse V6
video.notes: duration INTEGER 1-15. generate_audio_switch default false. A newer PixVerse C1 exists.

video.label: Grok Imagine Video
video.notes: duration INTEGER 1-15. v1.5 exists at xai/grok-imagine-video/v1.5/image-to-video (not inspected).

video.label: Gemini Omni Flash 1.1
video.notes: duration INTEGER 3-10. Optional end_image_url.

video.label: FLUX 3 Image to Video
video.notes: Mixed-type duration: the string 'auto' OR an integer 5-20. safety_tolerance integer 0-4. generate_audio default true.
